scene_facts.evidence_status: Model-derived evidence from front-camera images; not human-confirmed ground truth.
scene_facts.work_duration: Strictly less than three days, user-confirmed; more precise duration unknown.
scene_facts.road_geometry: Urban, generally straight, two-way undivided street with curbs, sidewalks, grass strips, and a visible centerline/centerline remnant. Bicycle pavement markings are visible. Road geometry and surroundings change after the work area and at successive intersections.
scene_facts.traffic_directions: The survey vehicle travels forward. Vehicles facing the camera, including work trucks, use the opposing side; same-direction traffic is visible farther ahead. Exact lane count is not determined.
scene_facts.work_area_summary: At least two separately encountered work-related areas are supported: an initial localized work-vehicle/worker area on the roadway, followed later by a delineated roadway work area using numerous orange channelizers and a 'ROAD WORK AHEAD' sign.
scene_facts.lane_closure_vs_localized_obstruction: The earlier scene supports a localized obstruction or work-vehicle occupation, especially near the opposing side of the roadway; a formal lane closure is not established. The later channelized area narrows or shifts the usable roadway, but the exact closed portion and traffic-control limits are uncertain.
scene_facts.intersection_relationship: The initial work activity is encountered before a signalized or stop-controlled intersection sequence. Workers and equipment are near an intersection around 41.3-51.9 seconds. The survey vehicle then crosses a stop-controlled intersection around 51.9-62.5 seconds and proceeds toward another intersection/work area around 78.4-89.0 seconds. These segments should not be treated as one continuous layout.
scene_facts.workers_and_flagger_evidence: Several people in high-visibility clothing appear near the work vehicles and roadway. High-visibility clothing alone does not establish flagger activity. No person is clearly shown holding a STOP/SLOW paddle or otherwise visibly directing traffic; flagger activity is therefore unconfirmed.
scene_facts.apparent_work_vehicles: A sweeper-type truck marked 'HARRIER' is parked along the left side at 25.4 seconds. A large truck with an elevated conveyor/boom and a red construction machine are visible around 35.999-46.6 seconds. The precise equipment functions and operational status are uncertain. A U-Haul/self-storage vehicle is visible near 51.9-57.2 seconds but is not established as a work vehicle.
